zh: 移动端支持直接执行外部 CLI 技能并续接会话工作区：识别 @thcli-image 等外部命令行技能自动进入沙箱工作区并开放命令执行；管理员在移动端延续历史会话时自动续接原有工作目录，避免无审批弹窗卡顿，同时继续实时拦截危险操作类别。
en: Mobile execution for external CLI skills and workspace continuity: automatically enables scratch workspaces with command execution for external CLI skills such as @thcli-image; admins resuming an existing session from mobile keep its saved workspace root and execute non-dangerous commands smoothly without blocking on missing mobile approval prompts, while dangerous rules remain enforced.
